answer: Grade by random jury. Each epoch a public beacon assigns every submission to 7 graders drawn from the whole pool, and passing needs 4 approvals. A farm holding 300 of 2,000 graders (15%) gets a friendly majority on its own puppets only about 1.2% of the time, so nearly every junk answer meets honest readers. No puppet can steer itself onto a friendly island; the draw opens the grader atlas at a random page. To pass reliably, the farm must own most of the meadow, one paid identity at a time.
